newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's Repas to buy AEG software unit.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Repas to buy AEG software unit.

text.p: German control system specialist repas Prozess-Automation GmbH said on Thursday it would take over AEG Softwaretechnik GmbH, Berlin, effective October 1.
In a statement, repas said it planned to keep the AEG unit running as an independent unit. It did not disclose terms.
AEG Softwaretechnik specialises in technical applications for logistics, rail technology, engineering systems and control systems, repas said.
Repas, which has 140 staff, said it expected sales of 27 million marks in 1997.
AEG Softwaretechnik has around 70 staff and annual sales of around 13 million marks.
